adaptive_performance.detail: Adaptive preserves 100.8% of baseline throughput while cutting L4 delay to 49.9%.

attack_reduction.detail: Adaptive reduces composite attack success by 69.6% vs L0.

provenance.detail: Cryptographic parameter table with NIST FIPS 203/204, CKKS, and SecAgg sources generated.

statistical_support.detail: 10 seeds per configuration with 95% bootstrap CIs.

reproducibility.detail: Two runs of the same seed produced identical outputs.

honest_claims.detail: Paper explicitly separates modeled cryptographic overhead from formal security proofs.
